evidence: Frozen public notes require each snippet's history, every successful Save snapshot, and saved history survival across reload and process restart (overview.md:7; behaviour.md:34,40; integration.md:9). S21 creates Alpha/Beta plus updated monitor/carrier records and S23 repeatedly saves a concurrency record (functional/prompt.md:418-425,440-445). However S37 checks reload history only for its own fixture (prompt.md:472; functional/judge.toml:553), and S22 records restart history only for Primary and S37/S38 fixtures (prompt.md:430-432; judge.toml:588). Its whole-library comparison checks only current record fields (judge.toml:336). Thus not every existing record's historical collection is examined. Other plural checks and legitimate side-effect guards were checked and are appropriately scoped; full analysis is in per-row-review/evidence/31/analysis.md. Indexed scripted golden post-results.json reports nine records and history fixtures 1-9, but no exact-current configured judge or weak-app grading run was measured; scripted evidence does not expand the frozen judge instructions.
counterexample: A broken app preserves the current fields of all saved records and preserves history for Primary and S37/S38, but silently drops older snapshots of S21's Alpha/Beta/monitor/carrier or S23's repeatedly saved record after reload/restart. The instructed reload/restart history checks can pass although the public collection-wide promise fails.
suggested_fix: Capture and compare the complete revision-snapshot set for every saved identity with accepted Saves before and after reload and the single process restart, including S21 and S23 records, while retaining the existing current-field and selected-history checks.
